_provenance: Manually curated demo annotations. Literature entries are limited to well-known primary reports; verify before citing. Descriptions are general textbook knowledge.

caffeine.description: Trimethylxanthine purine alkaloid; adenosine-receptor antagonist and the most widely consumed psychoactive substance.
caffeine.biosynthesis: Purine nucleotide pathway: xanthosine is sequentially N-methylated by SAM-dependent N-methyltransferases (7-methylxanthosine → theobromine → caffeine).

theobromine.description: Dimethylxanthine alkaloid of cacao; biosynthetic precursor of caffeine.

nicotine.description: Pyridine–pyrrolidine alkaloid; agonist of nicotinic acetylcholine receptors.
nicotine.biosynthesis: Nicotinic acid (pyridine ring, from aspartate/NAD pathway) condensed with the N-methyl-Δ1-pyrrolinium cation derived from ornithine/putrescine.

morphine.description: Pentacyclic morphinan alkaloid of the opium poppy; μ-opioid receptor agonist.
morphine.biosynthesis: Two L-tyrosine units → (S)-norcoclaurine → (S)-reticuline → epimerisation to (R)-reticuline → salutaridine → thebaine → codeine → morphine.

codeine.biosynthesis: Formed from thebaine via neopinone/codeinone in the benzylisoquinoline pathway.

quinine.description: Cinchona alkaloid with a quinoline and quinuclidine unit; historic antimalarial.
quinine.biosynthesis: Monoterpenoid indole pathway: strictosidine (tryptamine + secologanin) rearranged to cinchonaminal and ultimately the quinoline nucleus.

atropine.description: Racemic hyoscyamine; muscarinic acetylcholine receptor antagonist.
atropine.biosynthesis: Tropine (from ornithine via N-methylputrescine and tropinone) esterified with tropic acid (rearranged phenyllactic acid from phenylalanine).

scopolamine.description: Epoxide tropane alkaloid (hyoscine); anticholinergic used against motion sickness.
scopolamine.biosynthesis: Hyoscyamine 6β-hydroxylase (H6H) converts hyoscyamine to scopolamine via 6β-hydroxyhyoscyamine.

cocaine.description: Tropane alkaloid ester from coca leaves; local anaesthetic and dopamine reuptake inhibitor.
cocaine.biosynthesis: Ornithine-derived N-methylpyrrolinium + two acetyl units → methylecgonone → methylecgonine, benzoylated by a BAHD acyltransferase.

berberine.description: Quaternary protoberberine alkaloid; bright yellow, antimicrobial.
berberine.biosynthesis: (S)-Reticuline → berberine bridge enzyme forms (S)-scoulerine → (S)-canadine → oxidation to berberine.

papaverine.description: Benzylisoquinoline alkaloid of opium; phosphodiesterase inhibitor and vasodilator.
papaverine.biosynthesis: Tyrosine-derived benzylisoquinoline pathway with extensive O-methylation and aromatisation of the isoquinoline ring.

strychnine.description: Heptacyclic monoterpenoid indole alkaloid; glycine-receptor antagonist and classic target of total synthesis.
strychnine.biosynthesis: Strictosidine → geissoschizine → Wieland–Gumlich aldehyde, which condenses with an acetate unit to give strychnine.

piperine.description: Piperidine amide responsible for the pungency of black pepper.
piperine.biosynthesis: Piperoyl-CoA (phenylpropanoid, via feruperic acid) coupled with piperidine (from lysine via cadaverine) by piperine synthase.

ephedrine.description: Phenylethylamine alkaloid; sympathomimetic amine from Ephedra.
ephedrine.biosynthesis: Phenylalanine → benzoic acid unit condensed with pyruvate → 1-phenylpropane-1,2-dione → cathinone → norephedrine → N-methylation.

harmine.biosynthesis: Tryptamine condensed with an acetaldehyde/pyruvate equivalent (Pictet–Spengler) followed by aromatisation and O-methylation.

camptothecin.description: Pentacyclic quinoline alkaloid; topoisomerase I inhibitor and lead for topotecan/irinotecan.
camptothecin.biosynthesis: Monoterpenoid indole pathway via strictosamide, with rearrangement of the indole into the quinoline system.

literature.authors: Wall, M. E.; Wani, M. C.; Cook, C. E.; Palmer, K. H.; McPhail, A. T.; Sim, G. A.
literature.title: Plant antitumor agents. I. The isolation and structure of camptothecin, a novel alkaloidal leukemia and tumor inhibitor from Camptotheca acuminata

capsaicin.description: Vanillylamide of 8-methylnon-6-enoic acid; TRPV1 agonist responsible for chilli pungency.
capsaicin.biosynthesis: Vanillylamine (phenylpropanoid pathway) condensed with a branched-chain fatty acyl-CoA (from valine) by capsaicin synthase (Pun1).

quercetin.description: Pentahydroxyflavonol; one of the most abundant dietary flavonoids, often occurring as glycosides.
quercetin.biosynthesis: p-Coumaroyl-CoA + 3 malonyl-CoA → naringenin chalcone (CHS) → naringenin → dihydrokaempferol (F3H) → dihydroquercetin (F3'H) → quercetin (FLS).

myricetin.biosynthesis: Dihydromyricetin (via F3'5'H) oxidised by flavonol synthase.

luteolin.biosynthesis: Flavone synthase acting on eriodictyol, or 3'-hydroxylation of apigenin.

chrysin.biosynthesis: From cinnamoyl-CoA (not p-coumaroyl-CoA) via pinocembrin and flavone synthase.

naringenin.description: Flavanone of citrus; central intermediate of flavonoid biosynthesis.
naringenin.biosynthesis: Chalcone isomerase cyclisation of naringenin chalcone.

hesperetin.description: Methoxylated flavanone; aglycone of hesperidin in citrus peel.

genistein.biosynthesis: Isoflavone synthase (CYP93C) 2,3-aryl migration of naringenin, then dehydration.

daidzein.biosynthesis: Isoliquiritigenin (via chalcone reductase) → liquiritigenin → isoflavone synthase.

baicalein.biosynthesis: Root-specific pathway via cinnamoyl-CoA, pinocembrin and chrysin with 6-hydroxylation.

tangeretin.biosynthesis: Successive O-methylation and hydroxylation of flavone precursors.

curcumin.description: Yellow diarylheptanoid pigment of turmeric rhizome; exists in keto–enol tautomeric equilibrium (drawn here in the diketo form).
curcumin.biosynthesis: Type III PKS pathway: diketide-CoA synthase (DCS) and curcumin synthase (CURS) condense two feruloyl-CoA units with malonyl-CoA.

literature.authors: Milobedzka, J.; von Kostanecki, S.; Lampe, V.
literature.title: Zur Kenntnis des Curcumins

resveratrol.description: trans-3,5,4'-Trihydroxystilbene; phytoalexin of grapevine and other plants.
resveratrol.biosynthesis: Stilbene synthase (type III PKS) condenses p-coumaroyl-CoA with 3 malonyl-CoA using an aldol cyclisation with decarboxylation.

menthol.description: (1R,2S,5R)-Menthol, the cooling monoterpene alcohol of peppermint; TRPM8 agonist.

limonene.description: (R)-(+)-Limonene, main constituent of orange peel oil.
limonene.biosynthesis: Limonene synthase cyclisation of geranyl diphosphate via the α-terpinyl cation.

geraniol.description: Acyclic monoterpene alcohol with rose-like odour.
geraniol.biosynthesis: Geraniol synthase hydrolysis of geranyl diphosphate (MEP pathway).

linalool.description: Tertiary acyclic monoterpene alcohol; stereocentre unspecified in this record.
linalool.biosynthesis: Linalool synthase acting on GPP via the linalyl cation.

camphor.description: Bicyclic monoterpene ketone; (1R,4R)-(+)-enantiomer from camphor laurel.
camphor.biosynthesis: GPP → bornyl diphosphate (bornyl diphosphate synthase) → borneol → camphor (dehydrogenase).

borneol.description: Bicyclic monoterpene alcohol from Borneo camphor.

alpha_pinene.description: Bicyclic monoterpene; major component of turpentine.
alpha_pinene.biosynthesis: Pinene synthase: GPP → α-terpinyl cation → pinyl cation → deprotonation.

carvone.description: p-Menthane monoterpene ketone; (R)-(−)-enantiomer, the characteristic odorant of spearmint (the (S)-(+)-enantiomer occurs in caraway).

thymol.description: Aromatic monoterpene phenol of thyme; antiseptic.
thymol.biosynthesis: γ-Terpinene aromatised by P450 hydroxylation and dehydrogenation.

eucalyptol.description: 1,8-Cineole, bicyclic monoterpene ether dominating eucalyptus oil.
eucalyptol.biosynthesis: 1,8-Cineole synthase: α-terpinyl cation captured by water then intramolecular ether formation.

citral.biosynthesis: Oxidation of geraniol by alcohol dehydrogenases.

beta_caryophyllene.description: Bicyclic sesquiterpene with a cyclobutane ring; CB2 receptor agonist.
beta_caryophyllene.biosynthesis: Caryophyllene synthase cyclisation of FPP via a humulyl cation.

artemisinin.description: Sesquiterpene lactone endoperoxide from sweet wormwood; basis of first-line artemisinin combination antimalarial therapies.
artemisinin.biosynthesis: FPP → amorpha-4,11-diene (ADS) → artemisinic aldehyde (CYP71AV1) → dihydroartemisinic acid (DBR2, ALDH1) → photo-oxidative cascade to artemisinin.

literature.title: The discovery of artemisinin (qinghaosu) and gifts from Chinese medicine

parthenolide.description: Germacranolide sesquiterpene lactone of feverfew; NF-κB inhibitor.
parthenolide.biosynthesis: FPP → germacrene A → germacrene A acid → costunolide → parthenolide (epoxidation).

abietic_acid.description: Abietane diterpene resin acid, main component of rosin.
abietic_acid.biosynthesis: GGPP → (+)-copalyl diphosphate → abietadiene (bifunctional diterpene synthase) → P450 oxidation of C18.

paclitaxel.description: Taxane diterpenoid with an oxetane ring and N-benzoylphenylisoserine side chain; microtubule-stabilising anticancer drug.
paclitaxel.biosynthesis: GGPP → taxa-4(5),11(12)-diene (taxadiene synthase) → ~19 enzymatic steps including multiple P450 oxidations and acylations → baccatin III → side-chain attachment.

literature.authors: Wani, M. C.; Taylor, H. L.; Wall, M. E.; Coggon, P.; McPhail, A. T.
literature.title: Plant antitumor agents. VI. Isolation and structure of taxol, a novel antileukemic and antitumor agent from Taxus brevifolia

oleanolic_acid.description: Pentacyclic oleanane triterpenoid acid abundant in olive leaves.
oleanolic_acid.biosynthesis: 2,3-Oxidosqualene → β-amyrin (β-amyrin synthase) → C28 oxidation by CYP716A.

squalene.description: C30 acyclic triterpene; precursor of sterols and hopanoids. First characterised from shark liver oil.
squalene.biosynthesis: Head-to-head (1'-1) condensation of two FPP units by squalene synthase via presqualene diphosphate.

coumarin.description: 2H-Chromen-2-one; sweet hay-like odour of tonka beans.
coumarin.biosynthesis: Cinnamic acid ortho-hydroxylation (C2'H), trans/cis isomerisation and lactonisation.

psoralen.description: Linear furanocoumarin; DNA-intercalating photosensitiser used in PUVA therapy.
psoralen.biosynthesis: Umbelliferone C6-prenylation → demethylsuberosin → marmesin → psoralen (psoralen synthase, CYP71AJ1).

ferulic_acid.biosynthesis: Caffeoyl-CoA O-methyltransferase (CCoAOMT) or COMT methylation of caffeic acid derivatives.

p_coumaric_acid.description: 4-Hydroxycinnamic acid; entry point of the general phenylpropanoid pathway.

sinapic_acid.description: 3,5-Dimethoxy-4-hydroxycinnamic acid; precursor of syringyl lignin and sinapate esters.

cinnamaldehyde.description: Principal flavour of cinnamon bark oil.

eugenol.description: Allyl phenylpropene of clove oil; dental analgesic.
eugenol.biosynthesis: Coniferyl acetate reduced by eugenol synthase (NADPH-dependent).

anethole.biosynthesis: p-Coumaryl acetate → chavicol-type reduction by isoeugenol-synthase homologue → O-methylation.

chlorogenic_acid.description: 5-O-Caffeoylquinic acid; major phenolic of coffee beans.
chlorogenic_acid.biosynthesis: Hydroxycinnamoyl-CoA:quinate hydroxycinnamoyl transferase (HQT) transfers caffeoyl-CoA to quinic acid.

rosmarinic_acid.description: Ester of caffeic acid and 3,4-dihydroxyphenyllactic acid; antioxidant of Lamiaceae.
rosmarinic_acid.biosynthesis: Rosmarinic acid synthase couples caffeoyl-CoA (phenylalanine route) with hydroxyphenyllactic acid (tyrosine route).

penicillin_g.description: Benzylpenicillin: β-lactam–thiazolidine antibiotic that inhibits bacterial transpeptidases. Fleming's producing strain was re-identified as Penicillium rubens.
penicillin_g.biosynthesis: Non-ribosomal: ACV synthetase condenses L-α-aminoadipate, L-cysteine and L-valine → isopenicillin N synthase (IPNS) forms the bicyclic core → acyl-CoA:IPN acyltransferase exchanges the side chain for phenylacetyl.

literature.title: On the antibacterial action of cultures of a penicillium, with special reference to their use in the isolation of B. influenzae

literature.authors: Houbraken, J.; Frisvad, J. C.; Samson, R. A.
literature.title: Fleming's penicillin producing strain is not Penicillium chrysogenum but P. rubens

vancomycin.description: Glycopeptide antibiotic that binds the D-Ala-D-Ala terminus of peptidoglycan precursors; last-line agent against MRSA.
vancomycin.biosynthesis: Non-ribosomal peptide synthetase assembles a heptapeptide (including β-hydroxytyrosines and 4-hydroxy-/3,5-dihydroxyphenylglycines) → P450 (OxyA–C) oxidative cross-links → glycosylation with glucose and vancosamine.

lovastatin.description: Fungal HMG-CoA reductase inhibitor (mevinolin); prototype statin.
lovastatin.biosynthesis: Iterative highly reducing PKS LovB with enoyl reductase LovC builds dihydromonacolin L (intramolecular Diels–Alder) → monacolin J → LovD transfers the 2-methylbutyryl side chain from LovF.

literature.title: Mevinolin: a highly potent competitive inhibitor of hydroxymethylglutaryl-coenzyme A reductase and a cholesterol-lowering agent

emodin.biosynthesis: Octaketide from acetyl-CoA + 7 malonyl-CoA (non-reducing PKS) → atrochrysone carboxylic acid → emodin anthrone → oxidation.
